how_its_made:
Built with Next.js and Cairo

Next.js for Frontend: We leverage the power of Next.js, a popular React framework, to build a fast, responsive, and user-friendly interface. Next.js allows us to create dynamic web applications with server-side rendering, ensuring a smooth user experience and optimal performance.

 Cairo for Smart Contracts: On the backend, our platform uses Cairo, a powerful programming language designed for writing secure and scalable smart contracts on blockchain networks. Cairo ensures that all transactions and task completions are securely recorded on the blockchain, providing transparency and trust.
